review_candidates.description: NVIDIA is looking for a brilliant senior Software & Systems Architect to join the NIC Software/Firmware Architecture group. Be part of a team of outstanding people, whose mission is to craft the upcoming datacenter DPU generation. Collaborate with hardware and software architects, R&D teams, and external customers. Take ownership of end-to-end system design across NICs, switches, accelerators, and GPU devices and focus on defining and reviewing system-level flows, ensuring they meet performance, reliability, and manageability requirements. What You’ll Be Doing Define, analyse and review system-level architecture and data/control flows connecting NICs, switches, accelerators, and GPUs and their dependencies. Design and review QoS policies and traffic management schemes to meet latency, bandwidth, and isolation requirements. Define and review system management flows, including configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle operations. Specify telemetry, observability, and monitoring requirements end-to-end (NIC–switch–accelerator–GPU). Conduct and lead architecture and design reviews with R&D teams, ensuring alignment with system requirements and constraints and maintain high-level system diagrams, interface definitions, and design documents. Work closely with customers, product management, and field teams to understand use cases and translate them into system-level requirements and serve as the primary point of contact for system level questions raised by customers, architects, and R&D teams. Support investigations of complex system issues, performance bottlenecks, and interoperability problems. What We Need To See B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 6+ years of shown experience in the field. Deep understanding of networking concepts and protocols (L2/L3/L4, routing/switching, QoS, congestion-control). Experience with high-performance systems involving NICs, switches, accelerators, and/or GPUs. Proven experience in system-level architecture, data-flow design, or large-scale system integration. Familiarity with configuration and management protocols and frameworks, e.g., Netconf/REST, gNMI, SNMP, gRPC-based APIs, or similar. Experience defining or consuming telemetry/observability systems (counters, traces, logs, streaming telemetry). Strong ability to create clear architecture documents and diagrams and to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally with architecture, R&D, and customer-facing teams. Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude for resolving complex system issues. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience with datacenter, AI/ML, and/or HPC network architectures. Background with RDMA, RoCE, NVMe-oF, or similar high-performance I/O technologies. Customer-facing experience in architecture, solution engineering, or technical pre/post-sales roles. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to extraordinary growth, our elite engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a sincere real passion for technology, we want to hear from you. NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. , , JR2015023

Experience in banking or financial services IT environments is an advantage, particularly with core banking systems. Good communication skills, customer-focused attitude, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How We're Different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. review_candidates.title: Postdoctoral Fellowship - Pockets of Effectiveness and the Diffusion of Organizational Capacity
review_candidates.description: The Department of Sociology at the University of Notre Dame, with the support of the Kellogg Institute for International Studies, invites applications for a one-year Postdoctoral Fellowship to join a research project on the spread of organizational effectiveness within low-income states. The project is led by Dr. Erin Metz McDonnell and asks whether, how, and under what conditions effective bureaucratic practices from "pockets of effectiveness"—government units that perform well despite institutionally challenging environments—can be successfully implemented elsewhere in the state. The project design combines a comparative qualitative case analysis of six regional commercial courts in Ghana with a quantitative study of the spread of ADR across the broader Ghanaian court system. Beyond the already-collected Ghanaian qualitative data, the project will include an international field experiment and an extended set of international comparative cases tracking what happened after initial success — whether pockets of effectiveness spread their practices, maintained their niche, or organizational performance declined. The Fellow will collaborate closely with Dr. McDonnell on data analysis, literature development, and the preparation of scholarly articles, with the expectation of co-authorship on articles where the Fellow has made substantive contributions. The project also supports Dr. McDonnell's in-progress solo-authored book, and the Fellow will have opportunities to contribute to that work through analytic support, literature synthesis, and editorial feedback. Beyond the core project, the Fellow will be encouraged to develop independent research questions that extend the project's theoretical framework and to present findings at national conferences. If the candidate has established connections in a country with a case that would be suitable for development as a comparative case for the project, some fieldwork funding may be possible. This position is based at the University of Notre Dame, and all project work can be conducted from South Bend using data already collected or currently being collected by the PI. No fieldwork in Ghana is required. The project is methodologically flexible: candidates with strengths in qualitative, quantitative, or mixed methods are all encouraged to apply, and the specific balance of responsibilities will be shaped in part by the Fellow's own training and interests. The Fellow will benefit from the interdisciplinary intellectual community at Notre Dame, including the Kellogg Institute for International Studies—which brings together scholars of states, development, and governance across sociology, political science, economics, and law—and the Sociology Department's strengths in political, organizational, and development sociology, with a growing cluster of scholars working in the Global South. This is an in-person postdoctoral position based at the University of Notre Dame in Notre Dame, Indiana. The appointment is for a one-year term beginning July 1, 2026, with the option of a June start date if preferred by the candidate. The position opens on April 20, 2026, with rolling review of applications until the position is filled. The salary is $70,000, and the appointment includes a comprehensive benefits package with health insurance and access to university resources. Qualifications Applicants must have a PhD in sociology or a related field (political science, public policy, development studies, organizational studies, or similar) by the time of the position start. We are looking for an intellectually curious researcher with strong analytic, writing, and time management skills, the ability to juggle multiple workstreams independently, a genuine interest in organizational and political sociology, and comfort moving between theoretical development and empirical analysis. Particularly Welcome Skills And Experiences Include Training in qualitative methods, including qualitative comparative analysis Training in quantitative methods, including panel data. GIS spatial analysis would be a plus. Experience with lab or field experiments Substantive background in one or more of: organizational sociology, political sociology, sociology of development, the sociology of states, or African studies Prior experience working with data from low- or middle-income country settings A track record of scholarly writing, including peer-reviewed publications, working papers, or advanced dissertation chapters Candidates do not need to have expertise across all of these areas. The Fellow's specific role will be shaped collaboratively to build on their existing strengths and development goals. review_candidates.title: Chief Financial Officer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Nanaimo Forest Products Ltd. (NFPL), operating as Harmac Pacific, is a privately owned British Columbia–based, partially employee-owned company producing approximately 400,000 tonnes per year of Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp, one of the highest-value pulp products globally. Since 2010, NFPL has invested more than $300 million in capital improvements across its pulp and energy operations, including significant investments in production infrastructure, renewable energy generation, and facility modernization. The company serves international markets across Asia, North America, and Europe, and is recognized as both a specialty and commodity pulp producer, leveraging unique fibre inputs such as Douglas Fir, Hemlock, and Red Cedar to produce differentiated grades. A key strategic differentiator for NFPL is its integrated energy platform. The Harmac Pacific site includes a biomass-fueled cogeneration facility that converts residual fibre inputs—such as sawdust and bark—into renewable electricity and process steam. Since 2014, the company has supplied carbon-neutral power to BC Hydro, generating enough energy to serve more than 28,000 homes annually. This contracted power business provides a stable and complementary revenue stream alongside the cyclical pulp market. NFPL Is Actively Advancing Energy Growth Initiatives, Including Expansion of generation capacity through new boiler and turbine infrastructure Evaluation and relocation of existing boiler assets to increase output Participation in funding programs (e.g., CleanBC, Investment in Forestry Industry Transformation (IFIT), and infrastructure financing) Exploration of low-carbon energy solutions and renewable energy credits These initiatives represent a significant opportunity to enhance long-term EBITDA stability and strengthen the company’s sustainability profile. In Addition To Its Operating Assets, NFPL Owns Strategically Located Industrial Land Adjacent To The Harmac Site. This Land Is Currently Under Consideration For Industrial Rezoning And Future Development And Offers Proximity to deep-water port access Existing infrastructure, including water treatment and energy systems Potential for development into an industrial park, logistics hub, or complementary processing operations This landholding provides long-term growth optionality and diversification potential beyond NFPL’s core pulp and energy businesses. NFPL employs more than 350 people and supports over 1,000 jobs in the region. Its ownership model is unique: 25% employee-owned Remaining ownership held by BC-based investors across three holding entities Governed by a six-member Board, with equal representation among ownership groups The company operates with a lean, collaborative, and hands-on culture, where leaders are expected to be actively involved in the business and contribute broadly to performance and decision-making. VISION To produce and supply premium Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp to global markets through operational excellence, innovation, and a commitment to quality, sustainability, and teamwork. MISSION To be a world-class, employee-owned pulp producer recognized for delivering high-quality products, operating sustainably, and competing successfully in global markets. VALUES Quality: Guided by the principle that "Quality is the Key" to success. Sustainability: Commitment to environmental stewardship, renewable energy generation, and responsible resource use. Collaborative Teamwork: Emphasis on employee ownership, partnership, and shared success. Innovation: Use of technology, creativity, and continuous improvement to remain competitive. Position Overview The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a key member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the General Manager & CEO and working closely with the Board and ownership groups. This is a hands-on, operational leadership role in a lean organization. The CFO will lead all financial functions while contributing broadly to strategic planning, capital allocation, and operational decision-making. The role requires strong capability in providing stewardship for their core pulp business which includes navigating a capital-intensive, globally exposed, and cyclical commodity business, but also helping to find strategic levers to expand their power generation and real estate development aspirations. As a trusted advisor to the General Manager & CEO and Board, the CFO plays a central role in aligning financial planning, risk management, and infrastructure development to help diversify and strengthen recuring revenue for the group with direct responsibility for operational and capital budgets, financial controls, audit processes, enterprise risk management, insurance, and legislative compliance, while ensuring sound stewardship of resources and long-term financial sustainability. As a senior leader, the CFO will foster strong working relationships across the organization and with external stakeholders including government, auditors, industry partners, and regulatory bodies. The role is responsible for building and sustaining high-performing teams, mentoring, and creating a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement. With a strong focus on data-informed decision-making, risk mitigation, and operational effectiveness, this position is critical to ensuring that Harmac Pacific operates with integrity, resilience, and strategic agility in a competitive pulp industry landscape. Download the Full Job Description: Nanaimo Forest Products - CFO.pdf We ask that candidates submit their application through MNP’s official process and refrain from approaching Nanaimo Forest Products Ltd. and/or its staff members directly. You may also send your resume directly to Kam Ketler at kam.ketler@mnp.ca

(이력서 자율양식) ✅ 스마트팩토리 시스템(스마트태그) 개발 및 운영 🚀 합류하실 팀을 소개해요 [IoT솔루션팀]은 소프트웨어 중심의 공장 SDF의 기반이 되는 현장과 시스템 연결을 위한 IoT 플랫폼, 차량 위치 추적 기반 스마트태그 개발, 구축, 운영을 담당하고 있습니다. 이를 통해, 국내/외 생산 법인들의 불필요한 생산 공정을 간소화하고 재고 관리 및 불량 제품 발생률을 낮추어 효율적인 생산을 이루어냈습니다. 팀원 구성은 시니어/주니어가 밸런스있게 분포되어 있어 선배들의 노하우와 주니어의 열정을 발판삼아 역량 강화가 가능한 조직입니다. 앞으로는 지능화 기술과 결합하여 고객의 니즈를 충족할 수 있는 비즈니스 방향을 제시해 나가고자 합니다. 💻 합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요 스마트태그 시스템 운영/개선 고객사/사용자 소통 및 요건 정의 일일/정기 점검 및 상시 모니터링 🔍 이런 분과 함께 하고 싶어요 응용프로그램 개발(Java Spring) 경험 RDBMS(Tibero/MySQL/Maria/Postgre SQL 중 2개 이상) 경험 센서/RFID 연동 시스템 개발/운영 설비, 단말, 시스템 간 인터페이스 경험(PLC통신, Socket통신, EAI통신 등) #Java #Tibero #My-SQL #Postgre 🔍 이런 분이라면 더욱 좋아요 제조 비즈니스에 대한 이해 컴퓨터, SW 등 IT관련 전공 Unity 3D 기반 서비스 개발 경험 MES 및 제조 관련 IT 시스템 개발/운영 경험 ⌛ 이렇게 합류해요 서류 접수 → 서류 검토 → 직무역량테스트(코딩) 및 인성검사 → 1차면접 → 2차면접 → 처우협의 및 채용검진 → 최종 합격🎉 ※ 상기 직무역량테스트 外 추가 역량평가가 진행될 수 있으며, 해당 결과는 종합적인 역량 검토를 위한 참고자료로 활용됩니다. 📍 만나게 될 근무지는 여기예요 울산 양정 📣 동료의 한 마디 안녕하세요 K책임입니다. 우리 팀은 서로의 강점을 존중하고, 부족한 부분을 채워주며 함께 성장하는 팀원들로 구성되어 있어요. 팀원들과 스터디를 진행하여 최신 기술을 공부하고, 새로운 아이디어를 공유하며 자기주도 학습을 장려하고 있답니다. 또한 언제든 질문하고 논의할 수 있는 개발적인 분위기 덕분에, 어려운 문제도 함께 해결해 나아가려는 팀워크가 돋보이는 팀이에요. 안녕하세요. G책임입니다. 우리 팀은 개인의 성장뿐 아니라 글로벌 인사이트를 얻는 데도 큰 도움이 될 것이라고 확신해요 :) 북미, 유럽 등 해외 출장의 기회가 많아 해외 경험을 쌓기에도 매우 좋답니다! 타 부서와 협업할 기회가 많아 자연스럽게 협업 능력을 향상시키고, 다양한 관점에서 문제를 바라보는 시각까지 키울 수 있어요. 우리 팀에 합류해, 함께 일하며 성장하는 기쁨을 느껴보세요! (팀 리더) IoT솔루션팀은 다양한 세대의 구성원들이 글로벌 경쟁력을 갖춘 스마트팩토리 구축을 목표로 맡은바 업무에 최선을 다하고 있습니다. '스마트 태그','IoT플랫폼' 이라는 자사 내재화 상품을 기반으로 고도화, 개발, 구축, 운영 토털 서비스를 제공 하고 있습니다. 스마트팩토리의 기초가 되는 현장과의 연결성을 제공하고, 수집된 데이터를 활용할 수 있는 체계를 서비스 합니다. 개발 전문가, 솔루션 개발/개선, PM, 운영 업무까지 다양한 업무를 수행하고 있으며, 현대차그룹뿐만 아니라 대외 고객사를 대상으로 최상의 서비스를 제공하는 전문가 집단으로 구성되어 있습니다. 서울 본사뿐만 아니라 현대차/기아 공장이 있는 지방 근무도 가능하여, 연고지에 따른 근무지 선택도 가능 합니다. 스마트팩토리 분야의 풀스택 개발자로서 역량을 확보하고 향후 글로벌 Top 레벨의 서비스를 딜리버리하는 PM/시니어개발자/컨설턴트로 성장하고 싶은 열정과 패기가 있다면 지금 바로 지원해 주시기 바랍니다 📌 참고해 주세요 채용 시 마감되는 상시 채용 공고로 운영되며, 채용 절차와 일정은 변동될 수 있어요. 사회적 배려 대상자(보훈 취업지원대상자, 장애인)는 관계 법령과 내규에 따라 우대해요. 모집 분야 및 담당 업무에 따라 영어 구술평가, 레퍼런스 체크, 또는 기타 전형이 실시될 수 있어요. 지원자의 경험과 역량을 고려하여 다른 포지션이 더 적합하다고 판단되는 경우 지원 분야가 변경될 수 있어요. 배치 부서 및 근무지는 회사 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있어요. 아래의 경우, 합격이 취소되거나 전형 진행에서 불이익을 받으실 수 있어요. 지원서가 사실과 다르거나 증빙이 불가할 경우 해외여행 결격 사유가 있는 경우 (남성의 경우, 회사가 지정한 입사일까지 병역 필 또는 면제 필요) 최종 합격 후 회사가 지정하는 입사일에 입사 불가한 경우

review_candidates.title: Vice President of People & Talent (VP HR)
review_candidates.description: GET STARTED V is hiring a Vice President of People & Talent Founding Leadership Role | Equity-Based | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Get Started V is building a venture ecosystem from Riyadh designed to create, launch, and scale AI-first technology companies from Saudi Arabia to global markets. We are looking for an exceptional VP of People & Talent to build the people infrastructure behind that ambition. This is not a traditional HR role. We are looking for a builder who can create a high-performance organization from the ground up — attracting exceptional talent, designing scalable people systems, developing leadership, and building a culture capable of supporting multiple ventures and international expansion. The role will work closely with the Founder & CEO and executive leadership team across Get Started V and its portfolio ventures. Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Type: Founding Leadership / Executive Compensation: Equity-Based Reporting to: Founder & CEO The Mission Your mandate is simple but ambitious: Build the people engine that enables Get Started V to build companies at scale. You will design the systems required to identify, recruit, onboard, develop, retain, and organize exceptional people across the venture studio and its portfolio companies. As we grow, you will help ensure that our organizational capability grows faster than our complexity. What You Will Own1. Talent Strategy Develop the overall talent strategy for Get Started V and its ventures. You will determine: • What capabilities we need • Which roles should sit at studio level versus venture level • Which positions should be full-time, fractional, advisory, or equity-based • How leadership teams should evolve as ventures scale • How we build talent pipelines before positions become urgent 2. Executive & Founding Team Recruitment Lead recruitment for senior and founding positions across the ecosystem. This may include: • CEOs and Venture Leaders • Vice Presidents • Heads of Functions • Product and Technology Leaders • AI Engineers and AI Specialists • Growth and Marketing Leaders • Business Development Leaders • Operations Leaders • Designers and Product Builders You should be comfortable identifying and approaching exceptional candidates globally rather than relying exclusively on inbound applications. 3. Build the Recruitment Engine Create a repeatable recruitment system capable of supporting multiple companies simultaneously. Build processes covering: Sourcing → Screening → Assessment → Founder Interview → Reference Checks → Offer → Equity → Onboarding Introduce clear hiring scorecards and structured assessment methodologies so that hiring decisions become faster and more objective. 4. AI-Powered Talent Operations We expect AI to be deeply embedded into how we operate. You will explore and implement AI-driven workflows for: • Candidate sourcing • CV screening • Talent intelligence • Interview preparation • Candidate evaluation • Job description development • Onboarding • Employee knowledge systems • Performance management • Workforce planning • People analytics The objective is not simply to automate HR. The objective is to build a modern, AI-native People organization. 5. Organization Design Partner with leadership to design organizational structures across Get Started V and its ventures. You will help answer questions such as: • What should the leadership structure look like at each stage? • When should a venture build its own functional teams? • Which capabilities should remain centralized? • How do we maintain speed without creating unnecessary bureaucracy? • How should accountability and decision-making evolve as we scale? 6. Equity & Founding Talent Framework Many early leadership positions within our ecosystem are structured around equity. You will help establish professional frameworks covering: • Equity-based recruitment • Vesting structures • Founding-team expectations • Performance milestones • Leadership accountability • Long-term incentives • Retention mechanisms You must understand that recruiting entrepreneurial talent requires a fundamentally different approach from traditional corporate hiring. 7. Performance & Accountability Build a performance culture based on clear ownership and measurable outcomes. Develop frameworks covering: • Executive KPIs • Team objectives • Performance reviews • Leadership scorecards • Career development • Succession planning • Recognition systems • Performance improvement We want people to understand exactly what success looks like. 8. Culture & Founder Experience Help build a culture where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. Our culture should combine: Founder mentality + accountability + speed + ownership + integrity + human leadership. You will help translate these principles into actual operating practices — not posters on the wall. 9. Leadership Development As the organization grows, develop programs that strengthen our leadership bench. Identify high-potential individuals and create pathways for them to become: • Team Leads • Heads of Functions • Venture Executives • General Managers • Future Founders We want Get Started V to become a place where future company builders are developed. 10. Global Talent Network While this position is based in Riyadh, our talent strategy is global. Build relationships and talent pipelines across key ecosystems including: • Saudi Arabia and GCC • United States • United Kingdom and Europe • Asia • Global remote technology communities Riyadh should become the center of the ecosystem while talent can come from anywhere. What We Are Looking For You may come from: • A high-growth startup • Venture capital or venture building • Technology companies • Executive search • Global talent organizations • Startup recruiting • People operations • Organizational development More important than your title is your ability to build. You should understand: • Startup recruiting • Executive search • Organization design • Talent strategy • People operations • Leadership development • Performance management • Equity compensation • Employer branding • AI recruiting tools • HR technology and automation • International hiring You Will Probably Thrive Here If You are comfortable operating with ambiguity. You move quickly without sacrificing judgment. You can recruit executives and builders. You understand founders. You know how to identify exceptional talent before everyone else does. You believe HR should enable performance rather than create bureaucracy. You can design systems but are also willing to execute personally. You understand that early-stage companies require different people systems from large corporations. And you are excited about building something from Riyadh that can operate globally. First 12-Month Priorities Your initial mandate will include: • Establishing the Get Started V talent architecture • Building executive and technical talent pipelines • Recruiting critical leadership positions • Implementing structured hiring scorecards • Establishing the equity-talent framework • Building AI-powered recruiting workflows • Creating onboarding and performance systems • Developing the leadership pipeline • Building a global talent network • Strengthening Get Started V's employer brand Compensation This is an equity-based founding leadership opportunity. The role is designed for someone who wants meaningful ownership and wants to participate in the long-term value created by Get Started V and its ecosystem. This is not a conventional salaried corporate VP position. Candidates should carefully consider the entrepreneurial nature of the opportunity before applying. Why Join Get Started V? Saudi Arabia is entering one of the most significant periods of technology, entrepreneurship, and economic transformation in its history. We believe Riyadh has the opportunity to become one of the world's important centers for building the next generation of technology companies. Get Started V intends to participate in that future by building companies — not simply investing in them. For the right VP of People & Talent, this is an opportunity to build something much larger than an HR department. It is an opportunity to build the talent infrastructure behind an entire portfolio of companies. Based in Riyadh. Built for the world. If you are interested, apply through LinkedIn with your profile and a short explanation of how you would build a world-class talent engine for a venture studio from Riyadh.

review_candidates.title: System Architect - Railway Localization and Mapping
review_candidates.description: A Siemens Mobility Kft. K+F központjában, a XI. kerületi Infoparkban olyan projekteken dolgozunk, melyek biztosítják a zavartalan, fenntartható, megbízható és biztonságos közlekedést. Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility A projektről: K+F projektünk célja vasúti járművek asszisztált és vezető nélküli üzemeltetésének fejlesztése, valamint az automatikus vezetési funkciókra való felkészítés. A fejlesztés fókuszában az önvezető működés támogatása, váratlan akadályok esetén történő automatikus beavatkozás, illetve az automatikus funkciók folyamatos felügyelete áll. Ehhez stabil alapot biztosít a jármű pontos lokalizációja a digitális térképadatoknak megfelően. System Architect-ként ennek a központi rendszer- komponensnek a funkcionális továbbfejlesztéséért felelsz. A projekt több szereplős (vevő, konzorciumi partnerek), rendszerszintű gondolkodást igényel, és egy többfős, multidiszciplináris mérnökcsapat szoros együttműködésére épül. A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: A vasúti járművek támogatott és vezető nélküli üzemeltetéséhez kapcsolódó lokalizációs követelmények összegyűjtése, strukturálása és kezelése. A járműlokalizációval kapcsolatos rendszer- és alrendszerkövetelmények megfogalmazása, felülvizsgálati megbeszélések levezetése. A jármű funkcionális architektúrájának továbbfejlesztése a lokalizációhoz, a pályavonallal kapcsolatos térképkészítéshez és a jármű „haladási folyosójának” meghatározásához kapcsolódóan. A specifikációkban definiált ügyféligények megvalósítható műszaki megoldásokká alakítása, különös figyelmmel a biztonságra, pontosságra, rendelkezésre állásra, valamint a más járműrendszerekhez és automatizált üzemeltetési funkciókhoz kapcsolódó interfészekre Önállóan munkavégzés az adatelőkészítéstől egészen az elért pontosság értékeléséig A térképkészítésre és helymeghatározásra alkalmas módszerek kiértékelése, és információk nyújtása azok pontosságáról, ráfordításigényéről és skálázhatóságáról. Tesztadatokat előkészítése, teszteredmények kiértékelése, eltérések elemzése, és ezek alapján műszaki fejlesztési intézkedéseket meghatározása. Követelmények, megoldási koncepciók és teszteredmények egyeztetése a releváns érdekelt felekkel, kapcsolattartás és koordináció a telephelyek és szervezeti egységek között. Angol nyelvű műszaki dokumentáció készítése. Közreműködés az iparági térképadatok szabványosításában, a releváns műszaki kezdeményezések, szabványok és szakmai testületek munkájnak nyomon követése. T e vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel geodézia, geoinformatika, informatika, villamosmérnöki, fizikai vagy hasonló műszaki területen. Legalább 3 éves szakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel műszaki rendszerek fejlesztésében. Magabiztos ismeretekkel rendelkezel geoadatok, GIS-rendszerek, elterjedt geoadat-formátumok és geodéziai koordináta-rendszerek használatában. Tapasztalatod van helymeghatározási és térképkészítési eljárások terén, például GNSS-alapú módszerek, pontfelhők vagy távérzékelési (remote sensing) adatok alkalmazásában. Ismered a szoftverfejlesztés alapjait, különösen mérési, szenzor- és térképadatok kiértékelése, feldolgozása és elemzése kapcsán. Rendszerszinten gondolkodsz a pontosság, hibák és valószínűsíthetőség kérdéseiről, és ezekből megalapozott műszaki követelményeket tudsz levezetni. Tapasztalattal rendelkezel a követelménykezelés és a műszaki review-k területén. Gyorsan átlátod az összetett műszaki összefüggéseket, és képes vagy azokat strukturált módon egyeztetni különböző érdekelt felekkel. Folyékonyan beszélsz németül és angolul. Kiváló kommunikációs és együttműködési készségekkel rendelkezel. Szívesen és rugalmasan vállalsz utazást és helyszíni munkavégzést. A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben: Van korábbi tapasztalatod a vasúti iparágban, járműtechnikában vagy automatizált vezetési rendszerek területén A vasúti alapfogalmak, például a pályageometria, az űrszelvény vagy a biztonságkritikus rendszerek ismerete. Az AI-alapú érzékelési, adatfúziós, mintafelismerési vagy műszaki automatizálási eljárásokban szerzett tapasztalat. Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? Lehetőséget a projekttel kapcsolatos nemzetközi utazáson való részvételre. Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással. Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance. Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal. Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk. Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést. A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

review_candidates.description: ¿Tienes ganas de desarrollarte en una compañía en la que puedes llegar a ser socio/a? Nuestros valores esenciales son el Cliente, la Persona y el Desarrollo Profesional. Si te sientes identificado/a, ¡Sigue leyendo! SOBRE LA OPORTUNIDAD Desde el Área de Railway Systems queremos incorporar un/a especialista senior en sistemas para liderar el diseño, integración y entrega de sistemas de telecomunicaciones y control en grandes programas ferroviarios. El puesto requiere un/a líder técnicoa responsable del ciclo completo—desde el diseño hasta la puesta en servicio—actuando como autoridad técnica y coordinando interfaces multidisciplinares con señalización, energía y sistemas. El proyecto de vía y sistemas entregará un sistema ferroviario complejo alineado con estándares internacionales, incluyendo diseño, integración, instalación, pruebas y puesta en servicio de subsistemas de telecomunicaciones, control y ciberseguridad. Tus responsabilidades clave serían: Supervisar los subsistemas, entre los que se incluyen la red de comunicación de datos, el circuito cerrado de televisión (CCTV), los sistemas de gestión de activos, el sistema SCADA, el sistema de megafonía, el sistema de información al viajero, el centro de control operativo (OCC), los sistemas de comunicación inalámbrica (WiFi, GSM-R/FRMCS), las plataformas de telefonía y ciberseguridad, y el sistema de detección de peligros y alerta temprana. Gestionar las interfaces con los sistemas de señalización, energía de tracción, obra civil y material rodante. Garantizar el cumplimiento de las normas internacionales y los requisitos específicos del proyecto. Dirigir las revisiones técnicas, el control de calidad y la validación de los entregables de ingeniería. Coordinarse con el cliente, los contratistas, los fabricantes de equipos originales (OEM) y los equipos multidisciplinares. Prestar apoyo a las actividades de construcción, instalación, ensayo y puesta en servicio in situ. Gestionar los riesgos técnicos y garantizar el rendimiento y la seguridad del sistema. Dirigir y orientar a equipos de ingeniería multidisciplinares. Si te unes a IDOM encontrarás: Flexibilidad horaria. Teletrabajo 1 día a la semana o dos tardes. Jornada reducida de verano (julio y agosto). Retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, guardería….). Seguro de vida y accidentes. Conciliación vida familiar y profesional. Apuesta por carrera profesional a largo plazo. Acceso a la propiedad para todas las personas. Ambiente joven, multicultural y multidisciplinar. Actitud favorable a la delegación, más allá de lo habitual. Compromiso mutuo. SOBRE TÍ No dudes en aplicar si tienes.... Grado/licenciatura en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Eléctrica, Sistemas o equivalente). Ingeniero/a colegiado/a o equivalente (preferible). Miembro de organismo profesional reconocido. Desarrollo profesional continuo en sistemas ferroviarios. Mínimo 12+ años de experiencia en telecomunicaciones ferroviarias y sistemas de control. Alto nivel de Inglés (nivel C1 o similar). Experiencia en proyectos complejos con múltiples interfaces. Experiencia en todo el ciclo de vida del sistema. Participación en programas ferroviarios de gran escala. Competencias técnicas: Diseño de redes telecom (IP/MPLS, transmisión, VoIP); Sistemas de control (SCADA / ICSS); Ciberseguridad (IEC 62443, TS 50701); Integración de subsistemas Telecoms; Ingeniería de sistemas y gestión de requisitos; Procesos RAMS y V&V. Habilidades profesionales: Capacidad de liderazgo y coordinación de equipos; Gestión de stakeholders; Experiencia internacional; Capacidad de actuar como autoridad técnica. Movilidad / Despliegue: Disponibilidad para trabajo en obra; Presencia en fases clave del proyecto; Capacidad de trabajo en equipos internacionales. Y sobre todo... muchas ganas de aprender en una empresa internacional como IDOM. SOBRE NOSOTROS IDOM es una Asociación de Profesionales cuya actividad se enfoca en la realización de proyectos de Ingeniería, Arquitectura y Consultoría, que contribuyen a un mundo más sostenible. Las personas de IDOM estamos relacionadas por nuestro trabajo y por la propiedad de la Firma y cooperamos para lograr nuestro mayor desarrollo profesional y humano y el mejor servicio al Cliente. Es por ello que el patrimonio básico de IDOM es la valía y la experiencia de sus personas. Profesionales de alta cualificación y calidad humana, profundamente unidos, que trabajan en un marco de respeto a su identidad y libertad profesionales, con fuerte ambición de progreso, desarrollo, servicio e innovación. Desde nuestra fundación en 1957, el crecimiento ha sido continuo, constituyendo en la actualidad una organización multidisciplinar e integrada, de ámbito internacional, con presencia en 130 países en los que ejercemos nuestra actividad profesional más de 5.000 personas. ¿Estas preparado/a para dar el siguiente paso? Si te unes a nuestro EQUIPO podrás desarrollar tu carrera al más alto nivel, dentro de un entorno de profunda confianza y respeto profesional. Si compartes nuestra filosofía y quieres ser parte de nuestra compañía envíanos tu CV. ¡Queremos conocerte!

review_candidates.title: Government Affairs Lead - Middle East (UAE or Saudi Arabia based)
review_candidates.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About The Role We are building a Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team with the ambition and expertise to help shape one of the world's most dynamic environments for artificial intelligence and digital innovation. As our Government Affairs Lead for the Middle East, you will help establish and strengthen Cohere's presence across the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the other Gulf Coast countries ensuring the company's voice contributes to the development of AI policy, digital transformation, public-sector innovation, procurement, and economic diversification initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced government affairs professional who thrives at the intersection of government, technology, and public policy, and who wants to help position Cohere as a trusted partner supporting the region's ambitions to become a global leader in artificial intelligence. You will work alongside experienced policy leaders, collaborate closely with senior executives, and contribute directly to Cohere's strategic growth across two of the world's fastest-growing AI markets. Key Responsibilities Report directly to Cohere's Head of EMEA Government Affairs & Public Policy, partnering closely with senior leadership, legal, public policy, responsible AI, communications, and commercial teams to develop and execute Cohere's government affairs and stakeholder engagement strategy across the UAE and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Serve as Cohere's primary government affairs representative across the region, building trusted relationships with ministries, regulators, government authorities, public-sector organizations, sovereign entities, and innovation agencies. Monitor and assess legislative, regulatory, and public policy developments affecting artificial intelligence, cloud computing, data governance, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, and emerging technologies across the region. Support policy advocacy by developing consultation responses, policy submissions, briefing materials, executive talking points, and stakeholder engagement strategies related to AI regulation, digital economy initiatives, technology policy, and public procurement. Partner closely with commercial and public sector sales teams to support business development opportunities across government, financial services, telecommunications, energy, and other regulated industries. Collaborate with communications, marketing, and public relations teams to ensure consistent and effective messaging regarding Cohere's approach to responsible AI, innovation, and technology policy. Represent Cohere in industry associations, public-private partnerships, conferences, and policy forums across the Middle East. Develop and manage relationships with external government affairs consultants, advisors, and trade associations across the region. Ensure all government engagement, lobbying, and political activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable local laws, regulations, and company policies. Contribute to broader regional government affairs initiatives across the GCC and support cross-functional projects involving international stakeholders. Qualifications 7+ years of experience in government, a ministerial office, public policy, diplomacy, public-sector consulting, regulatory affairs, corporate government affairs, or a leading industry association. Strong understanding of the policymaking, regulatory, and public-sector landscape in either the United Arab Emirates or the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with the ability to quickly develop expertise across both markets. Experience building trusted relationships with senior government officials and public-sector stakeholders. Familiarity with AI policy, digital transformation, innovation policy, cloud technologies, public procurement, or technology regulation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex policy developments into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across international, cross-functional teams spanning multiple time zones. An entrepreneurial, self-starter mentality with excellent stakeholder management and project execution skills. Passion for artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and the opportunity to help shape the policy environment supporting responsible AI adoption. An undergraduate degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, business, economics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Preferred Qualifications Professional proficiency in Arabic. Existing relationships with government stakeholders in both the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Experience engaging with GCC institutions or regional organizations. Experience in enterprise software, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, or another emerging technology sector. Experience supporting government procurement, digital transformation, or national AI initiatives. Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How And Where We Work Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

review_candidates.title: Desk Side Support Field Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview NSC Global is looking for Level 1 Field Service Technicians to deliver on site technical support for customer systems. The role covers on site hardware troubleshooting, repair and replacement, diagnostics, service call updates, parts handling and customer communication, in line with agreed service levels and established field service procedures. Technicians attend customer locations, validate reported faults, complete the intervention and provide accurate updates throughout. The position requires sound technical troubleshooting ability, professional communication, close adherence to process and the ability to work to deadlines driven by service level agreements. Responsibilities Attend customer sites within agreed service windows and complete each intervention to the required standard. Perform on site troubleshooting, diagnostics, hardware repair and component replacement across desktops, laptops and related client hardware. Validate warranty status, asset identification and diagnostic findings before completing any repair. Apply approved diagnostic tools and methods, including built in diagnostics, LED fault codes and structured logical troubleshooting. Confirm receipt of service calls, manage estimated arrival updates and maintain accurate records in the required systems, with arrival updates within 15 minutes and closure within 30 minutes of service completion. Generate electronic service reports through the designated field service platform and obtain customer sign off following each intervention. Reinstall BIOS, drivers and operating systems where instructed and where approved recovery media is available. Troubleshoot hardware related networking faults falling within the scope of the service call. Order additional parts through the approved process, following completion of documented troubleshooting. Collect, manage, package, label and return defective or unused parts within the required process and timescales. Keep customers informed throughout the intervention, including next steps, repeat visits and parts requirements. Escalate unusual incidents immediately, including customer dissatisfaction, damage, missing equipment, unsafe environments or any issue affecting service delivery. Comply with all electrostatic discharge, safety and documented procedural requirements, and display the required identification while on customer sites. Report process deviations and quality issues, and contribute to continuous improvement. Qualifications Experience in Level 1 technical support, field service, desktop support, break/fix support or a comparable customer facing IT support role. Sound understanding of PC, laptop and client hardware components. Working knowledge of operating systems, BIOS, drivers, hardware fault isolation and basic networking principles. Ability to follow structured diagnostic processes and document troubleshooting steps accurately. Confident communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non technical customers. Ability to work independently at customer sites while observing agreed process, safety and escalation procedures. Strong time management across appointments, travel and service level expectations. High attention to detail in ticket updates, notes, parts handling and service reporting. Fluent written and spoken knowledge of the local language of the assigned territory, sufficient for direct customer contact on site. Proficient written and spoken English, sufficient for technical documentation, service reporting and communication with the wider support organisation. A valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to customer locations. CompTIA A+ certification is desirable, particularly for technicians new to this area of client hardware support. Tools and equipment Smartphone or tablet compatible with the required field service applications. Reliable internet connectivity suitable for field service updates and application use. Access to an electrostatic discharge kit and standard computer repair tools. Bootable USB key and the tools required for system disassembly and component replacement. Own vehicle available for daily travel between customer sites, with secure storage for tools and parts. Compliance and security Successful completion of all required criminal background checks prior to attending any customer site. Authorisation to work in the assigned territory in accordance with applicable law. Completion of all required authorisations and product, security, privacy and process training before performing service calls, and maintenance of that authorisation thereafter. Training is provided. Compliance with customer site access, security, privacy, safety and conduct requirements, and with all policies relating to confidential information, customer data and incident escalation. Technicians must be free of drugs and alcohol when performing service activity.

new_matches.title: Postdoctoral Fellowship - Pockets of Effectiveness and the Diffusion of Organizational Capacity
new_matches.description: The Department of Sociology at the University of Notre Dame, with the support of the Kellogg Institute for International Studies, invites applications for a one-year Postdoctoral Fellowship to join a research project on the spread of organizational effectiveness within low-income states. The project is led by Dr. Erin Metz McDonnell and asks whether, how, and under what conditions effective bureaucratic practices from "pockets of effectiveness"—government units that perform well despite institutionally challenging environments—can be successfully implemented elsewhere in the state. The project design combines a comparative qualitative case analysis of six regional commercial courts in Ghana with a quantitative study of the spread of ADR across the broader Ghanaian court system. Beyond the already-collected Ghanaian qualitative data, the project will include an international field experiment and an extended set of international comparative cases tracking what happened after initial success — whether pockets of effectiveness spread their practices, maintained their niche, or organizational performance declined. The Fellow will collaborate closely with Dr. McDonnell on data analysis, literature development, and the preparation of scholarly articles, with the expectation of co-authorship on articles where the Fellow has made substantive contributions. The project also supports Dr. McDonnell's in-progress solo-authored book, and the Fellow will have opportunities to contribute to that work through analytic support, literature synthesis, and editorial feedback. Beyond the core project, the Fellow will be encouraged to develop independent research questions that extend the project's theoretical framework and to present findings at national conferences. If the candidate has established connections in a country with a case that would be suitable for development as a comparative case for the project, some fieldwork funding may be possible. This position is based at the University of Notre Dame, and all project work can be conducted from South Bend using data already collected or currently being collected by the PI. No fieldwork in Ghana is required. The project is methodologically flexible: candidates with strengths in qualitative, quantitative, or mixed methods are all encouraged to apply, and the specific balance of responsibilities will be shaped in part by the Fellow's own training and interests. The Fellow will benefit from the interdisciplinary intellectual community at Notre Dame, including the Kellogg Institute for International Studies—which brings together scholars of states, development, and governance across sociology, political science, economics, and law—and the Sociology Department's strengths in political, organizational, and development sociology, with a growing cluster of scholars working in the Global South. This is an in-person postdoctoral position based at the University of Notre Dame in Notre Dame, Indiana. The appointment is for a one-year term beginning July 1, 2026, with the option of a June start date if preferred by the candidate. The position opens on April 20, 2026, with rolling review of applications until the position is filled. The salary is $70,000, and the appointment includes a comprehensive benefits package with health insurance and access to university resources. Qualifications Applicants must have a PhD in sociology or a related field (political science, public policy, development studies, organizational studies, or similar) by the time of the position start. We are looking for an intellectually curious researcher with strong analytic, writing, and time management skills, the ability to juggle multiple workstreams independently, a genuine interest in organizational and political sociology, and comfort moving between theoretical development and empirical analysis. Particularly Welcome Skills And Experiences Include Training in qualitative methods, including qualitative comparative analysis Training in quantitative methods, including panel data. GIS spatial analysis would be a plus. Experience with lab or field experiments Substantive background in one or more of: organizational sociology, political sociology, sociology of development, the sociology of states, or African studies Prior experience working with data from low- or middle-income country settings A track record of scholarly writing, including peer-reviewed publications, working papers, or advanced dissertation chapters Candidates do not need to have expertise across all of these areas. The Fellow's specific role will be shaped collaboratively to build on their existing strengths and development goals. Application Instructions Applicants Should Submit The Following Materials Via Interfolio Cover letter (2 pages maximum) indicating interest in the project and how the candidate's skills and perspective would contribute to it Curriculum vitae One writing sample (sole-authored preferred; a dissertation chapter, working paper, or published article is acceptable) Contact information for two references Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Questions may be directed to Dr. Erin Metz McDonnell at emmcdonn@nd.edu. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity. Dual Career Assistance To support relocating families, Notre Dame’s Dual Career Assistance Program helps spouses and partners pursue local career opportunities. Background Check This appointment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. Applicants will be asked to identify all felony convictions and/or pending felony charges. Felony convictions do not automatically bar an individual from employment. Each case will be examined separately to determine the appropriateness of employment in the particular position. Failure to be forthcoming or dishonesty with respect to felony disclosures can result in the disqualification of a candidate. The full procedure can be viewed at https://facultyhandbook.nd.edu/?id=link-73597.

new_matches.title: Chief Financial Officer
new_matches.description: About The Company Nanaimo Forest Products Ltd. (NFPL), operating as Harmac Pacific, is a privately owned British Columbia–based, partially employee-owned company producing approximately 400,000 tonnes per year of Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp, one of the highest-value pulp products globally. Since 2010, NFPL has invested more than $300 million in capital improvements across its pulp and energy operations, including significant investments in production infrastructure, renewable energy generation, and facility modernization. The company serves international markets across Asia, North America, and Europe, and is recognized as both a specialty and commodity pulp producer, leveraging unique fibre inputs such as Douglas Fir, Hemlock, and Red Cedar to produce differentiated grades. A key strategic differentiator for NFPL is its integrated energy platform. The Harmac Pacific site includes a biomass-fueled cogeneration facility that converts residual fibre inputs—such as sawdust and bark—into renewable electricity and process steam. Since 2014, the company has supplied carbon-neutral power to BC Hydro, generating enough energy to serve more than 28,000 homes annually. This contracted power business provides a stable and complementary revenue stream alongside the cyclical pulp market. NFPL Is Actively Advancing Energy Growth Initiatives, Including Expansion of generation capacity through new boiler and turbine infrastructure Evaluation and relocation of existing boiler assets to increase output Participation in funding programs (e.g., CleanBC, Investment in Forestry Industry Transformation (IFIT), and infrastructure financing) Exploration of low-carbon energy solutions and renewable energy credits These initiatives represent a significant opportunity to enhance long-term EBITDA stability and strengthen the company’s sustainability profile. In Addition To Its Operating Assets, NFPL Owns Strategically Located Industrial Land Adjacent To The Harmac Site. This Land Is Currently Under Consideration For Industrial Rezoning And Future Development And Offers Proximity to deep-water port access Existing infrastructure, including water treatment and energy systems Potential for development into an industrial park, logistics hub, or complementary processing operations This landholding provides long-term growth optionality and diversification potential beyond NFPL’s core pulp and energy businesses. NFPL employs more than 350 people and supports over 1,000 jobs in the region. Its ownership model is unique: 25% employee-owned Remaining ownership held by BC-based investors across three holding entities Governed by a six-member Board, with equal representation among ownership groups The company operates with a lean, collaborative, and hands-on culture, where leaders are expected to be actively involved in the business and contribute broadly to performance and decision-making. VISION To produce and supply premium Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp to global markets through operational excellence, innovation, and a commitment to quality, sustainability, and teamwork. MISSION To be a world-class, employee-owned pulp producer recognized for delivering high-quality products, operating sustainably, and competing successfully in global markets. VALUES Quality: Guided by the principle that "Quality is the Key" to success. Sustainability: Commitment to environmental stewardship, renewable energy generation, and responsible resource use. Collaborative Teamwork: Emphasis on employee ownership, partnership, and shared success. Innovation: Use of technology, creativity, and continuous improvement to remain competitive. Position Overview The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a key member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the General Manager & CEO and working closely with the Board and ownership groups. This is a hands-on, operational leadership role in a lean organization. The CFO will lead all financial functions while contributing broadly to strategic planning, capital allocation, and operational decision-making. The role requires strong capability in providing stewardship for their core pulp business which includes navigating a capital-intensive, globally exposed, and cyclical commodity business, but also helping to find strategic levers to expand their power generation and real estate development aspirations. As a trusted advisor to the General Manager & CEO and Board, the CFO plays a central role in aligning financial planning, risk management, and infrastructure development to help diversify and strengthen recuring revenue for the group with direct responsibility for operational and capital budgets, financial controls, audit processes, enterprise risk management, insurance, and legislative compliance, while ensuring sound stewardship of resources and long-term financial sustainability. As a senior leader, the CFO will foster strong working relationships across the organization and with external stakeholders including government, auditors, industry partners, and regulatory bodies. The role is responsible for building and sustaining high-performing teams, mentoring, and creating a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement. With a strong focus on data-informed decision-making, risk mitigation, and operational effectiveness, this position is critical to ensuring that Harmac Pacific operates with integrity, resilience, and strategic agility in a competitive pulp industry landscape. new_matches.title: Vice President of People & Talent (VP HR)
new_matches.description: GET STARTED V is hiring a Vice President of People & Talent Founding Leadership Role | Equity-Based | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Get Started V is building a venture ecosystem from Riyadh designed to create, launch, and scale AI-first technology companies from Saudi Arabia to global markets. We are looking for an exceptional VP of People & Talent to build the people infrastructure behind that ambition. This is not a traditional HR role. We are looking for a builder who can create a high-performance organization from the ground up — attracting exceptional talent, designing scalable people systems, developing leadership, and building a culture capable of supporting multiple ventures and international expansion. The role will work closely with the Founder & CEO and executive leadership team across Get Started V and its portfolio ventures. Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Type: Founding Leadership / Executive Compensation: Equity-Based Reporting to: Founder & CEO The Mission Your mandate is simple but ambitious: Build the people engine that enables Get Started V to build companies at scale. You will design the systems required to identify, recruit, onboard, develop, retain, and organize exceptional people across the venture studio and its portfolio companies. As we grow, you will help ensure that our organizational capability grows faster than our complexity. What You Will Own1. Talent Strategy Develop the overall talent strategy for Get Started V and its ventures. You will determine: • What capabilities we need • Which roles should sit at studio level versus venture level • Which positions should be full-time, fractional, advisory, or equity-based • How leadership teams should evolve as ventures scale • How we build talent pipelines before positions become urgent 2. Executive & Founding Team Recruitment Lead recruitment for senior and founding positions across the ecosystem. This may include: • CEOs and Venture Leaders • Vice Presidents • Heads of Functions • Product and Technology Leaders • AI Engineers and AI Specialists • Growth and Marketing Leaders • Business Development Leaders • Operations Leaders • Designers and Product Builders You should be comfortable identifying and approaching exceptional candidates globally rather than relying exclusively on inbound applications. 3. Build the Recruitment Engine Create a repeatable recruitment system capable of supporting multiple companies simultaneously. Build processes covering: Sourcing → Screening → Assessment → Founder Interview → Reference Checks → Offer → Equity → Onboarding Introduce clear hiring scorecards and structured assessment methodologies so that hiring decisions become faster and more objective. 4. AI-Powered Talent Operations We expect AI to be deeply embedded into how we operate. You will explore and implement AI-driven workflows for: • Candidate sourcing • CV screening • Talent intelligence • Interview preparation • Candidate evaluation • Job description development • Onboarding • Employee knowledge systems • Performance management • Workforce planning • People analytics The objective is not simply to automate HR. The objective is to build a modern, AI-native People organization. 5. Organization Design Partner with leadership to design organizational structures across Get Started V and its ventures. You will help answer questions such as: • What should the leadership structure look like at each stage? • When should a venture build its own functional teams? • Which capabilities should remain centralized? • How do we maintain speed without creating unnecessary bureaucracy? • How should accountability and decision-making evolve as we scale? 6. Equity & Founding Talent Framework Many early leadership positions within our ecosystem are structured around equity. You will help establish professional frameworks covering: • Equity-based recruitment • Vesting structures • Founding-team expectations • Performance milestones • Leadership accountability • Long-term incentives • Retention mechanisms You must understand that recruiting entrepreneurial talent requires a fundamentally different approach from traditional corporate hiring. 7. Performance & Accountability Build a performance culture based on clear ownership and measurable outcomes. Develop frameworks covering: • Executive KPIs • Team objectives • Performance reviews • Leadership scorecards • Career development • Succession planning • Recognition systems • Performance improvement We want people to understand exactly what success looks like. 8. Culture & Founder Experience Help build a culture where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. Our culture should combine: Founder mentality + accountability + speed + ownership + integrity + human leadership. You will help translate these principles into actual operating practices — not posters on the wall. 9. Leadership Development As the organization grows, develop programs that strengthen our leadership bench. Identify high-potential individuals and create pathways for them to become: • Team Leads • Heads of Functions • Venture Executives • General Managers • Future Founders We want Get Started V to become a place where future company builders are developed. 10. Global Talent Network While this position is based in Riyadh, our talent strategy is global. Build relationships and talent pipelines across key ecosystems including: • Saudi Arabia and GCC • United States • United Kingdom and Europe • Asia • Global remote technology communities Riyadh should become the center of the ecosystem while talent can come from anywhere. What We Are Looking For You may come from: • A high-growth startup • Venture capital or venture building • Technology companies • Executive search • Global talent organizations • Startup recruiting • People operations • Organizational development More important than your title is your ability to build. You should understand: • Startup recruiting • Executive search • Organization design • Talent strategy • People operations • Leadership development • Performance management • Equity compensation • Employer branding • AI recruiting tools • HR technology and automation • International hiring You Will Probably Thrive Here If You are comfortable operating with ambiguity. You move quickly without sacrificing judgment. You can recruit executives and builders. You understand founders. You know how to identify exceptional talent before everyone else does. You believe HR should enable performance rather than create bureaucracy. You can design systems but are also willing to execute personally. You understand that early-stage companies require different people systems from large corporations. And you are excited about building something from Riyadh that can operate globally. First 12-Month Priorities Your initial mandate will include: • Establishing the Get Started V talent architecture • Building executive and technical talent pipelines • Recruiting critical leadership positions • Implementing structured hiring scorecards • Establishing the equity-talent framework • Building AI-powered recruiting workflows • Creating onboarding and performance systems • Developing the leadership pipeline • Building a global talent network • Strengthening Get Started V's employer brand Compensation This is an equity-based founding leadership opportunity. The role is designed for someone who wants meaningful ownership and wants to participate in the long-term value created by Get Started V and its ecosystem. This is not a conventional salaried corporate VP position. Candidates should carefully consider the entrepreneurial nature of the opportunity before applying. Why Join Get Started V? Saudi Arabia is entering one of the most significant periods of technology, entrepreneurship, and economic transformation in its history. We believe Riyadh has the opportunity to become one of the world's important centers for building the next generation of technology companies. Get Started V intends to participate in that future by building companies — not simply investing in them. For the right VP of People & Talent, this is an opportunity to build something much larger than an HR department. It is an opportunity to build the talent infrastructure behind an entire portfolio of companies. Based in Riyadh. Built for the world. If you are interested, apply through LinkedIn with your profile and a short explanation of how you would build a world-class talent engine for a venture studio from Riyadh.

A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: A vasúti járművek támogatott és vezető nélküli üzemeltetéséhez kapcsolódó lokalizációs követelmények összegyűjtése, strukturálása és kezelése. A járműlokalizációval kapcsolatos rendszer- és alrendszerkövetelmények megfogalmazása, felülvizsgálati megbeszélések levezetése. A jármű funkcionális architektúrájának továbbfejlesztése a lokalizációhoz, a pályavonallal kapcsolatos térképkészítéshez és a jármű „haladási folyosójának” meghatározásához kapcsolódóan. A specifikációkban definiált ügyféligények megvalósítható műszaki megoldásokká alakítása, különös figyelmmel a biztonságra, pontosságra, rendelkezésre állásra, valamint a más járműrendszerekhez és automatizált üzemeltetési funkciókhoz kapcsolódó interfészekre Önállóan munkavégzés az adatelőkészítéstől egészen az elért pontosság értékeléséig A térképkészítésre és helymeghatározásra alkalmas módszerek kiértékelése, és információk nyújtása azok pontosságáról, ráfordításigényéről és skálázhatóságáról. Tesztadatokat előkészítése, teszteredmények kiértékelése, eltérések elemzése, és ezek alapján műszaki fejlesztési intézkedéseket meghatározása. Követelmények, megoldási koncepciók és teszteredmények egyeztetése a releváns érdekelt felekkel, kapcsolattartás és koordináció a telephelyek és szervezeti egységek között. Angol nyelvű műszaki dokumentáció készítése. Közreműködés az iparági térképadatok szabványosításában, a releváns műszaki kezdeményezések, szabványok és szakmai testületek munkájnak nyomon követése. T e vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel geodézia, geoinformatika, informatika, villamosmérnöki, fizikai vagy hasonló műszaki területen. Legalább 3 éves szakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel műszaki rendszerek fejlesztésében. Magabiztos ismeretekkel rendelkezel geoadatok, GIS-rendszerek, elterjedt geoadat-formátumok és geodéziai koordináta-rendszerek használatában. Tapasztalatod van helymeghatározási és térképkészítési eljárások terén, például GNSS-alapú módszerek, pontfelhők vagy távérzékelési (remote sensing) adatok alkalmazásában. Ismered a szoftverfejlesztés alapjait, különösen mérési, szenzor- és térképadatok kiértékelése, feldolgozása és elemzése kapcsán. Rendszerszinten gondolkodsz a pontosság, hibák és valószínűsíthetőség kérdéseiről, és ezekből megalapozott műszaki követelményeket tudsz levezetni. Tapasztalattal rendelkezel a követelménykezelés és a műszaki review-k területén. Gyorsan átlátod az összetett műszaki összefüggéseket, és képes vagy azokat strukturált módon egyeztetni különböző érdekelt felekkel. Folyékonyan beszélsz németül és angolul. Kiváló kommunikációs és együttműködési készségekkel rendelkezel. Szívesen és rugalmasan vállalsz utazást és helyszíni munkavégzést. Az AI-alapú érzékelési, adatfúziós, mintafelismerési vagy műszaki automatizálási eljárásokban szerzett tapasztalat. Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk. Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést. El puesto requiere un/a líder técnicoa responsable del ciclo completo—desde el diseño hasta la puesta en servicio—actuando como autoridad técnica y coordinando interfaces multidisciplinares con señalización, energía y sistemas. Gestionar las interfaces con los sistemas de señalización, energía de tracción, obra civil y material rodante. Garantizar el cumplimiento de las normas internacionales y los requisitos específicos del proyecto. Dirigir las revisiones técnicas, el control de calidad y la validación de los entregables de ingeniería. Coordinarse con el cliente, los contratistas, los fabricantes de equipos originales (OEM) y los equipos multidisciplinares. Prestar apoyo a las actividades de construcción, instalación, ensayo y puesta en servicio in situ. Gestionar los riesgos técnicos y garantizar el rendimiento y la seguridad del sistema. Dirigir y orientar a equipos de ingeniería multidisciplinares. Si te unes a IDOM encontrarás: Flexibilidad horaria. Teletrabajo 1 día a la semana o dos tardes. Jornada reducida de verano (julio y agosto). Retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, guardería….). Seguro de vida y accidentes. Conciliación vida familiar y profesional. Apuesta por carrera profesional a largo plazo. Acceso a la propiedad para todas las personas. Ambiente joven, multicultural y multidisciplinar. Actitud favorable a la delegación, más allá de lo habitual. Compromiso mutuo. SOBRE TÍ No dudes en aplicar si tienes.... Grado/licenciatura en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Eléctrica, Sistemas o equivalente). Ingeniero/a colegiado/a o equivalente (preferible). Miembro de organismo profesional reconocido. Desarrollo profesional continuo en sistemas ferroviarios. Mínimo 12+ años de experiencia en telecomunicaciones ferroviarias y sistemas de control. Alto nivel de Inglés (nivel C1 o similar). Experiencia en proyectos complejos con múltiples interfaces. Experiencia en todo el ciclo de vida del sistema. Participación en programas ferroviarios de gran escala. Competencias técnicas: Diseño de redes telecom (IP/MPLS, transmisión, VoIP); Sistemas de control (SCADA / ICSS); Ciberseguridad (IEC 62443, TS 50701); Integración de subsistemas Telecoms; Ingeniería de sistemas y gestión de requisitos; Procesos RAMS y V&V. Habilidades profesionales: Capacidad de liderazgo y coordinación de equipos; Gestión de stakeholders; Experiencia internacional; Capacidad de actuar como autoridad técnica. Movilidad / Despliegue: Disponibilidad para trabajo en obra; Presencia en fases clave del proyecto; Capacidad de trabajo en equipos internacionales. Y sobre todo... muchas ganas de aprender en una empresa internacional como IDOM. SOBRE NOSOTROS IDOM es una Asociación de Profesionales cuya actividad se enfoca en la realización de proyectos de Ingeniería, Arquitectura y Consultoría, que contribuyen a un mundo más sostenible. Las personas de IDOM estamos relacionadas por nuestro trabajo y por la propiedad de la Firma y cooperamos para lograr nuestro mayor desarrollo profesional y humano y el mejor servicio al Cliente. Es por ello que el patrimonio básico de IDOM es la valía y la experiencia de sus personas. Profesionales de alta cualificación y calidad humana, profundamente unidos, que trabajan en un marco de respeto a su identidad y libertad profesionales, con fuerte ambición de progreso, desarrollo, servicio e innovación. Desde nuestra fundación en 1957, el crecimiento ha sido continuo, constituyendo en la actualidad una organización multidisciplinar e integrada, de ámbito internacional, con presencia en 130 países en los que ejercemos nuestra actividad profesional más de 5.000 personas. ¿Estas preparado/a para dar el siguiente paso? Si te unes a nuestro EQUIPO podrás desarrollar tu carrera al más alto nivel, dentro de un entorno de profunda confianza y respeto profesional. Si compartes nuestra filosofía y quieres ser parte de nuestra compañía envíanos tu CV. ¡Queremos conocerte!
